title: 第3章 混淆是非
content_zh:
听到唐风的声音，林若鸢赶紧回头安抚他道：“风儿别动，这事我一定给你个交代！”

杨玉儿在旁边气得咬牙切齿，刚才唐风跟她理论的时候分明中气十足，哪有现在这般虚弱痛苦？恶狠狠地瞪了唐风一眼，眼中满是警告和威胁的意思，却不料正看到唐风对着她挤眉弄眼，别提多**了。

杨玉儿为之气结，恨不得当场拔剑，一剑结果了这个臭男人，却碍于林若鸢在此，不敢有所动作，只能将一口恶气吞回肚中。

正在此时，门外又接连急匆匆地走进来四位妇人打扮的女子，为首一人风华正茂，气质不凡，容貌虽然不能说是绝色，可也是上上之姿，只不过常年来的操劳让这位妇人眼角出现了一些鱼尾纹。她身后跟着的其他三人也是都是秀外惠中，兰质蕙心的女子。

天秀高层最有话语权的几个人全来了！唐风自然认得当先一人正是天秀当代宗主，白素衣。她身后三人也都是跟林若鸢平起平坐的其他三位长老。

算起来，天秀高层五人只能是二代弟子，秦小婉和杨玉儿她们是三代弟子。至于第一代弟子的行踪还是个谜。

见到宗主来临，屋内的所有人都恭敬行礼。

唐风装模作样挣扎着要下床见礼，稍微一动，忍不住疼的呻吟一声，额头细汗密布，这倒不是装得，毕竟自己的魂魄才跟这具身体融合，有很多不便之处，而且胸口的那道剑伤委实疼人。

“你躺着。”白素衣纤手一挥，一股柔和的力道将唐风摁了下来。

“谁能告诉我，到底发生了什么事？”白素衣淡淡地扫过众人，轻声开口问道。她也只是接到消息说有人刺杀唐风，前去禀报的那个弟子并没有将刺杀者的名字说出来。

林若鸢站起身来，冷冷地看着一帮三代弟子道：“有人想杀风儿！”

“是谁？”白素衣秀眉一挑，眼眸中一丝怒气闪过，虽然说唐风在整个天秀就相当于一块牛粪，可他的另外一层身份由不得白素衣不重视。尽管白素衣也不喜欢唐风，却不得不委曲求全，让唐风在十六岁之前待在天秀宗。

三代弟子以杨玉儿为首，全都垂下了脑袋。

“唐风你说。”见问不出什么，白素衣索性将问题抛给了唐风。

“我不说，我怕有人跟我秋后算账。”唐风翻了翻白眼。

“有我和几位长老为你主持公道，你不需要顾忌什么。”白素衣淡淡道。

“呵呵。”唐风微微笑了笑：“在这天秀内宗深幽之地，有人能在我胸口上刺第一剑，就能够刺第二剑。我唐风实力不济，惹不起。再说了，屋子里也就这么些人，谁伤了我难道不是一目了然的事情么？还需要我说什么？”

“唐风你放肆！”白素衣身后一位长老大怒，唐风话里的讥讽之意在场众人谁听不出来，摆明了就是说宗主的空头支票无法保证唐风的安全。

白素衣挥手打断了这位长老的话，在屋内扫了一圈，最终定格在秦小婉的身上。

事实也确实如此，屋内就这么些人，秦小婉现在傻乎乎地站在那，一只手还保持着持剑的姿势，地上掉落的长剑更是秦小婉佩戴之物，就算唐风不指认，长眼睛的都能看到。

白素衣之所以让唐风指认，也只是以退为进的手段，好把事情大事化小，小事化了。以唐风原本的性格，肯定是不敢指认的，这样这件事就算揭过去了。可白素衣也没想到，唐风一点面子也不卖，委实将她推到了一个死胡同里。

“她这是怎么了？”白素衣疑惑地问道。

“不知道，我们来的时候小婉妹妹就这样了。”杨玉儿轻声答道。

仔细查看了一翻秦小婉现在的状态，白素衣也是一头雾水。外伤，内伤，没有一丝痕迹。秦小婉就好像看到了及其恐惧的一幕，硬生生地被吓成这样。

唐风深沉无比地点了点头：“可能是怕血！刺我一剑之后她就这样了。”

白素衣眉头一皱，瞪了唐风一眼，显然认为他在胡说八道。

唐风也奇怪无比，刚才他一直在思索秦小婉为何刺自己一剑，惨叫一声之后就变成这幅德行，思来想去，也只能给秦小婉总结个晕血症的原因。

但是晕血症也不应该是这样啊，秦小婉应该直接昏倒才对，可为什么她一双眼睛瞪得老大，傻傻地盯着自己。

白素衣将掌心摁在秦小婉的额头上，也没见她有什么动作，半晌之后，秦小婉哇地一声痛哭了出来，整个人直接瘫倒在地上，娇躯更是瑟瑟发抖。

杨玉儿赶紧搂住秦小婉，轻拍着她的背，柔声安慰道：“别怕别怕，没事了。”

“鬼怪！鬼怪！”秦小婉惊恐无比的呼喊着，使劲往杨玉儿怀抱中拱去。

被秦小婉这么一喊，其他三代弟子顿时觉得有些风声鹤唳，冷风嗖嗖。

“闭嘴！”其中一位长老喝道，这位长老名叫易若晨，正是秦小婉的师傅。

听到易若晨的叱喝，秦小婉忍不住流下泪来，虽然还是惊恐，可总算有些回过神了：“我真的看到了，在唐风的眼中！”

“还嫌不够丢人么？”易若晨大怒，上前来一巴掌甩了过去，吧唧一声脆响，一道五指深痕印在秦小婉那张如花似玉的俏脸上。

“小婉，你为什么要杀唐风？”白素衣居高临下，俯视着秦小婉开口问道。

秦小婉兀自捂着脸颊，怎么也想不明白为什么平日里对自己疼爱无比的师傅，今天居然打了自己一巴掌。

等到白素衣很不耐烦地问了第二遍之后，秦小婉才缓过神来，将早就捏造好的借口娓娓道来：“唐风今天莫名其妙地晕倒之后，我就想来看看他。却不料……”

说到这里，秦小婉抬眼弱弱地看了唐风一眼，宛若一个受尽欺凌的小女孩。

“却不料什么？”易若晨冷声问道。

“唐风他对我在言语上多有挑逗，我恼怒之下正要离开，唐风他就兽性大发，想将我摁倒在床上……”

屋内一片鄙夷之声顿时响起，无数美眸喷着怒火朝唐风看来。

秦小婉俨然很入戏，将自己遭受的屈辱尽数表现在脸上，委屈无比：“逼不得已之下，我就转身刺了他一剑！”
content_en:
Hearing Tang Feng's voice, Lin Ruoyuan quickly turned around to comfort him and said: "Feng'er, don't move, I will definitely give you an explanation for this matter!"

Yang Yu'er was gnashing her teeth with anger. Tang Feng was clearly very angry when he was arguing with her just now. How could he be as weak and painful as he is now?She glared at Tang Feng fiercely, her eyes full of warning and threats, but unexpectedly she saw Tang Feng winking at her, not to mention a lot of sex.

Yang Yu'er was so angry that she wanted to draw her sword on the spot and kill this stinky man with one sword. However, because Lin Ruoyuan was here, she didn't dare to make any move and could only swallow the bad breath back in her stomach.

At this moment, four more women dressed as women hurriedly walked in from outside the door. The first one was in full bloom and had an extraordinary temperament. Although her appearance could not be said to be stunning, she was still of a classy appearance. However, years of hard work had caused some crow's feet to appear at the corners of this woman's eyes.The other three people following her are also women with beautiful appearance and beautiful heart.

The most powerful people from Tianxiu’s top management are all here!Tang Feng naturally recognized that the person in front of him was Tianxiu's contemporary sect leader, Bai Suyi.The three people behind her are also the other three elders who are equal to Lin Ruoyuan.

All in all, the top five people in Tianxiu can only be second-generation disciples, while Qin Xiaowan and Yang Yu'er are third-generation disciples.As for the whereabouts of the first generation disciples, it is still a mystery.

Seeing the sect master coming, everyone in the room bowed respectfully.

Tang Feng pretended to struggle to get out of bed to see the ceremony. When he moved a little, he couldn't help but groan in pain. His forehead was covered with sweat. This was not just pretending. After all, his soul had just merged with this body, which had many inconveniences. Moreover, the sword wound on his chest was really painful.

"Lie down." Bai Suyi waved her slender hand and pressed Tang Feng down with a soft force.

"Who can tell me what happened?" Bai Suyi glanced at the crowd and asked softly.She only received news that someone had assassinated Tang Feng, and the disciple who went to report it did not name the assassin.

Lin Ruoyuan stood up, looked at a group of third-generation disciples coldly and said, "Someone wants to kill Feng'er!"

"Who is it?" Bai Suyi raised her eyebrows, and a trace of anger flashed in her eyes. Although Tang Feng was equivalent to a piece of cow dung in Tianxiu, his other identity could not be ignored by Bai Suyi.Although Bai Suyi didn't like Tang Feng either, she had to compromise and let Tang Feng stay in Tianxiu Sect until he was sixteen.

The three generations of disciples, headed by Yang Yuer, all lowered their heads.

"Tang Feng, tell me." Seeing that nothing came out of the question, Bai Suyi simply threw the question to Tang Feng.

"I won't tell you, because I'm afraid someone will settle the score with me." Tang Feng rolled his eyes.

"I and several elders will uphold justice for you, so you don't have to worry about anything." Bai Suyi said calmly.

"Haha." Tang Feng smiled slightly: "In this deep and secluded place of Tianxiu Inner Sect, if someone can stab me with the first sword on my chest, he can stab with the second sword. I, Tang Feng, am not strong enough and cannot afford to offend him. Besides, there are only so many people in the room. Isn't it obvious who hurt me? What else do I need to say?"

"Tang Feng, you are so presumptuous!" An elder behind Bai Suyi was furious. No one present could hear the sarcasm in Tang Feng's words. It was clear that the sect leader's empty promise could not guarantee Tang Feng's safety.

Bai Suyi waved her hand to interrupt the elder's words, scanned around the room, and finally settled on Qin Xiaowan.

This is indeed the case. There are only so many people in the room. Qin Xiaowan is standing there stupidly, one hand still holding the sword. The long sword that fell on the ground is what Qin Xiaowan is wearing. Even if Tang Feng doesn't identify it, anyone with eyes can see it.

The reason why Bai Suyi asked Tang Feng to identify him was just to make a retreat in order to make the matter smaller and make it a trivial matter.With Tang Feng's original character, he would definitely not dare to identify him, so the matter would be revealed.But Bai Suyi didn't expect that Tang Feng didn't show any respect at all and actually pushed her into a dead end.

"What's wrong with her?" Bai Suyi asked doubtfully.

"I don't know. Sister Xiaowan was like this when we came here." Yang Yu'er replied softly.

After carefully checking Qin Xiaowan's current status, Bai Suyi was also confused.No trace of external or internal injuries.Qin Xiaowan seemed to have seen an extremely frightening scene, and was frightened like this.

Tang Feng nodded deeply: "Maybe she's afraid of blood! She became like this after stabbing me with a sword."

Bai Suyi frowned and glared at Tang Feng, obviously thinking that he was talking nonsense.

Tang Feng was also very strange. Just now, he had been thinking about why Qin Xiaowan stabbed him with a sword and screamed and then turned into this kind of behavior. After thinking about it, he could only sum up the reason for Qin Xiaowan's dizziness and blood poisoning.

But haemorrhage shouldn't be like this. Qin Xiaowan should have fainted directly, but why did her eyes widen and she stared at herself stupidly.

Bai Suyi pressed her palm on Qin Xiaowan's forehead, but she didn't see any movement. After a while, Qin Xiaowan burst into tears and collapsed directly to the ground, her delicate body trembling even more.

Yang Yu'er quickly hugged Qin Xiaowan, patted her back, and comforted her softly: "Don't be afraid, don't be afraid, it's okay."

"Ghost! Ghost!" Qin Xiaowan shouted in fear, and pushed into Yang Yu'er's arms.

When Qin Xiaowan shouted like this, the other three generations of disciples suddenly felt a bit rustling and the cold wind whistling.

"Shut up!" shouted one of the elders. This elder's name was Yi Ruochen, and he was Qin Xiaowan's master.

Hearing Yi Ruochen's scolding, Qin Xiaowan couldn't help but shed tears. Although she was still frightened, she finally came to her senses: "I really saw it, in Tang Feng's eyes!"

"Isn't it embarrassing enough?" Yi Ruochen was furious, stepped forward and slapped him with a slap, and there was a crisp sound, and a deep mark with five fingers was imprinted on Qin Xiaowan's pretty face, which was as beautiful as a flower.

"Xiaowan, why did you want to kill Tang Feng?" Bai Suyi looked down at Qin Xiaowan and asked.

Qin Xiaowan was covering her cheek, and she couldn't figure out why the master who usually loved her so much actually slapped her today.

After Bai Suyi asked impatiently for the second time, Qin Xiaowan regained consciousness and explained the excuse she had made up long ago: "After Tang Feng fainted for no reason today, I wanted to come and see him. But unexpectedly..."

Having said this, Qin Xiaowan raised her eyes and glanced at Tang Feng weakly, like a little girl who had been bullied.

"Unexpectedly?" Yi Ruochen asked coldly.

"Tang Feng was very verbally teasing towards me. I was about to leave in anger, but Tang Feng became so animalistic that he wanted to push me down on the bed..."

A sound of disdain suddenly sounded in the room, and countless beautiful eyes looked at Tang Feng with anger.

Qin Xiaowan seemed to be very into the drama, showing all the humiliation she suffered on her face, feeling extremely wronged: "I had no choice but to turn around and stab him!"
